reviews.title: Reviewer girl
reviews.text: Hello everyone! I just want to rate this game and please come along with me. This game is very fun, get a mate, raise baby wolfs, kill bosses, it’s very fun. But some problems make the game a bit frustrating. #1 ads, ads are the worst thing you can get in a game, and I know developers that they help keep the game free for everyone but their are a lot and it makes you frustrated. #2 I like this game you can lvl up, but that’s the problem, you don’t really get as many lvls before you get mad and confused. And on lvl 11 on my computer it won’t cross off that lvl. Is it a glitch? Part of the game? And you only spend most of your time just doing that for a long time. #3  their are so many quests and I like that (I really really do) but mostly just killing animals, can we pls have a rescue mission or something? It would be nice not attacking animals who are scared, and I mostly refuse to kill the animals. #4 on the runs where you can get coins can we pls get more? I have a hard time moving around and don’t get as many coins as you need too, also can you developers pls make the crawling a little bit faster? Pls #5 this is a forest not a jungle. I sometimes find gorillas and elephants like does that really make sense? And developers I know you guys want to have a challenge but maybe be more………realistic? Like a wolf and elephant?!?!? Like wha?!?!!! #6 (well this is not a problem just a shoutout) you can customize your wolf and later I will rate it for some people who don’t have this and I love that you don’t have to spend REAL MONEY for a wolf, like some games are crazy, but the point is: you need to earn stuff in the game to buy skins and masks and junk, and this is a 2 star. That is it for some problems in the game I missed some glitches but not a lot, at the start you get some but then not a lot. Having this is good it’s not 100% perfect.. I would say 68% perfect but still a good game. Now the time we have all been waiting for………… the stars! Alright, 1 star for not many ads, 2 stars for not spending real money, and…………… 1 star for madness!                                                                                                      Sincerely reviewer girl. P.S. next review is going to be zen color pls make your way there once reading this find: *Reviewer girl* to see my review byee!

reviews.title: The levels repeat once you complete all of them, etc.
reviews.text: I think it is slightly annoying that the levels repeat, so please make more. Another thing, you get to choose and customize your wolf, but in the game you are always a male wolf, and you have to have a mate. It’s a fine story, but why did you let us customize our wolf if you are always set to one thing in the story? Nice animal animations, but all the animals that are fast in real life are slow. But, I do like how watching ads just means there is a small pop up on the middle of the top of the screen. I also see many typos, and, besides all the animals, every other texture is… not as good as the animal’s texture. Also, I saw in one of the levels that all of your cubs are named (in the game the name was capitals) “MAX”. Over all, fun-ish game for me, and this is just my opinion, you may have other ideas about it. (And you don’t get to fight tigers like the App Store picture suggested.)

reviews.title: Scamming kids is low guys😐😑🙄
reviews.text: This game is not what I imagined you’re basically scamming kids. I mean if you just look at the title and if you open the game and see the background before it even starts, it looks pretty cool. but when you open the game, it’s not like what you saw. On the ad you saw grass that looks pretty nice. You could see trees with good graphics. You can see a pack. When you open the game, there’s a guide that tells the controls then you go on a mission to hunt some stags. But the one thing is hunting It’s really easy. All you have to do is chase press the attack button do it a few times and then you got it. That’s not realistic hunt. It should be hard for wolves and they should fight back a little bit too instead of always run away maybe have some of them fight and some of them run. And can you please add baby animals to the game one it would be more interesting to watch animals take care of their babies. It would be really interesting if you could hunt some baby stag calfs, but to the other animals, too, baby elephants, baby leopards and more! And I’m sure if kids were playing this. They would expect more graphics than this. Add more trees to make it a forest. It’s kinda like a desert, but not quite though the ground looks like a desert, but there’s still some trees and there’s a pond nearby. And when you try to find boars in the area there’s there’s nothing there no boars! So I had to skip the mission. The amount of ads is also pretty high. Can you please add more realistic forest animals? Like you’re a wolf you don’t live in Africa wolves live in many places in the world they live in Europe they live in Canada they live in the USA they also live in the Arctic but none live in Africa so I don’t know why you added this to the game. you could also have pups in this game, but before you have pups. You find a female wolf shouldn’t you choose your gender so you’re basically a boy in this game. That’s disappointing. I wanted to be a girl but instead we’re forced to be a boy. After you do all the missions with your pups. They do the same levels again. This is why people should not make levels in their games please add more details to this game
